title: DexmedetOmidine Complement Treats Chronic insOmnia and Improves Circadian Rhythm (DOCTOR)
brief_summary: It has been reported that dexmedetomidine, alpha-2 adrenoceptor agonist, can activate endogenous neural sleep pathways in the central nervous system. This randomised, double-blinded and controlled trial was designed to investigate whether dexmedetomidine can improve/treat chronic insomnia patients. Its effects on sleep quality and improvement, EEG and circadian rhythm, brain connectivity, cognition and biomarker changes are determined.
